lede: Utah carries the stronger underlying team rating — +6.4 against +0.2, a 6.2-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Iowa State +9.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Utah winning 74% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is continuity, where Utah leads Iowa State by 101 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 76% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
